item: merge.py: every write names main., a scan test keeps it so, and the CI floor-leg pin is tied to the pytest step
summary: The 64 remaining unqualified INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP TRIGGER statements in merge.py now name main., so a corpus missing a table fails loudly instead of the write falling through to the attached backup. tests/test_merge_writes_name_main.py scans the module's string constants and f-strings (statement start only) with an empty allowlist and a behavioural case (merge_batches dropped from the live corpus: the merge fails, the incoming file is byte-identical). The #1392 CHECK-2 nits: the floor-leg pin now requires the export in the env of the step that runs pytest.
